description: Question-to-answer regression cases, collected from real reported incidents. Each case's `unit` block runs fully offline in `node --test` against the embedded `fixtures` (no network, no model, no DB). Each case's `e2e.assert` block runs against the live Ask pipeline via POST /api/ask/regression/run (admin) after a deploy. The assert format follows promptfoo's deterministic assertion conventions (icontains / not-icontains / icontains-any / equals: https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/configuration/expected-outputs/); the source-* and guardrail-* types are custom asserts in the same shape, checking the structured fields the Ask API already returns. Pin only facts that can never change (a CVE's vendor, banned strings, official hosts); keep version lists as icontains-any so newer fix releases never false-fail a case.
